categories.title: Operational Questions

items.question: Who are the teachers at Quranik?
items.answer: A distinguished group of Quran memorizers and licensed scholars from Gaza, selected based on their Tajweed proficiency and modern pedagogical methods.

items.question: Is the service paid? And why?
items.answer: Yes, it is a paid service with carefully considered subscription fees. The goal is to ensure the project's sustainability and provide a dignified, stable income for our teachers in Gaza, preserving their dignity and supporting their resilience.

items.question: What age groups are targeted?
items.answer: We target children and young people in the diaspora, with dedicated programs also available for adults who wish to correct their recitation or obtain an Ijazah.

items.question: How are lessons delivered?
items.answer: Through an interactive online platform that enables direct audio and video communication between teacher and student, with tools for tracking memorization and periodic assessments.

items.question: Do I need a high-speed internet connection?

categories.title: Legal & Privacy Questions

items.question: What is your privacy policy for my children's data?
items.answer: We adhere to the highest global data protection standards. All personal information is encrypted, and sessions are only recorded with written parental consent and solely for quality assurance purposes.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription and get a refund?

items.question: Do you offer a free trial?

privacy.metaDescription: At Quranik, we are committed to the highest standards of transparency and protection of your children's data, ensuring a safe and trustworthy learning environment.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: At Quranik, we believe that trust is the cornerstone of our institution. We do not view your data as numbers — we treat it as a responsibility. As a community service institution, Quranik is committed to the highest standards of transparency in collecting, using, and protecting your data, in order to provide a safe and trustworthy learning environment for your children.

sections.title: 1. What Data Do We Collect?
sections.content: We collect only the minimum data necessary to provide our educational service, including:

items.title: Registration Data:
items.content: Name, email address, phone number, and student information (age, academic level).

items.title: Communication Data:
items.content: To ensure effective coordination of lessons between the diaspora and Gaza.

items.title: Performance Data:
items.content: Teacher notes on student progress, to track memorization and Tajweed development.

items.title: Payment Data:
items.content: (Not stored on our servers) — processed through secure international payment gateways that protect your financial information.

sections.title: 2. How Do We Use Your Data?

items.title: Service Delivery:
items.content: To organize study schedules and facilitate communication between students and teachers.

items.title: Educational Quality:
items.content: To analyze learning performance and develop curricula in ways that benefit the student.

items.title: Community Impact:
items.content: We use aggregated statistical data (non-personal) to show donors and impact partners how your subscription helps empower teachers in Gaza, without disclosing individual identities.

sections.title: 3. Student Data Protection
sections.content: We follow strict data protection policies, including:
items: We do not collect any data without the consent of the student or their guardian.
Communication between teacher and student takes place only through the official platform or approved channels under administrative oversight.
The use of student data or personal information for any external marketing purposes is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: 4. Third Parties (Transparency)
sections.content: We use technical tools (learning platforms, payment gateways, communication software) to deliver our services. These partners are bound by strict privacy standards and only have access to your data to the extent necessary to complete the service.

sections.title: 5. Your Data Rights
sections.content: As our partners in this mission, you have the full right to:
items: Access the data held about you or your children.
Request the permanent deletion of your data from our records if you wish to end your subscription.

sections.title: 6. Our Commitment Under Exceptional Circumstances
sections.content: We are committed to protecting your data under all circumstances. Even in the event of any emergency in Gaza, your data is stored on protected cloud servers and can only be accessed by the authorized administrative team to ensure continuity of service.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any inquiries regarding the Privacy Policy, please contact us via email:

terms.metaDescription: The terms and conditions of Quranik Educational Institution — our community charter for supporting Gaza's teachers and ensuring quality education for our children.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Quranik Community Educational Institution

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Quranik is a purposeful community educational institution, founded to bridge the gap between our children in the diaspora and the wellspring of the Holy Quran. Our operating model is not purely commercial — it is a model of "sustainable empowerment," where subscription revenues are directed to supporting educators in Gaza and providing a dignified working environment befitting the teachers and guardians of the Holy Quran under difficult circumstances.

sections.title: 1. The Nature of Our Community Relationship
sections.content: When you subscribe to Quranik, you are not simply purchasing an educational service — you are contributing to a tangible social impact. Your subscription represents an investment in:
items: Empowering Quran teachers in Gaza — both financially and professionally.
Ensuring the continuity of education in Palestine despite all challenges.
Building a bridge of knowledge and values between our children abroad and our people in Gaza.

sections.title: 2. Fees & Financial Commitment
items: Subscription fees are the primary source of funding that Quranik relies on to sustain the work of our teachers. We are therefore fully committed to transparency in how these revenues are used to support the teaching staff.
Payments are made periodically and in advance to ensure continuous session scheduling and to secure teachers' monthly compensation.

sections.title: 3. Academy Commitments (Flexibility Charter Under Exceptional Circumstances)
sections.content: We operate from the heart of Gaza, which requires mutual understanding of force majeure circumstances from both sides:

specialBox.title: Compensation, Not Refunds:
specialBox.description: In the event of power outages, internet disruptions, or any force majeure circumstances beyond the teacher's control, we do not immediately resort to refunds. Instead, the academy is committed to fully compensating for all missed sessions at the earliest available opportunity.
specialBox.note: This principle is part of our social contract with you — guaranteeing the student's right to education and the teacher's right to receive their due compensation for their effort, even if delivery is delayed.

sections.title: 4. Subscription Cancellation
items: If a student wishes to cancel their subscription, we kindly ask for notice at least (7) business days before the start of the new academic cycle.

We believe in flexibility; therefore, in the event of exceptional personal circumstances, we can temporarily freeze the subscription rather than cancel it, to ensure continued support for the assigned teacher.

sections.title: 5. Privacy & Data Protection
sections.content: As a community educational institution, we regard our students' data as a trust. Sessions are not recorded and no personal data is shared except for the purpose of evaluating educational performance, and only with the explicit consent of the guardian.

sections.title: 6. Learning Environment Conduct
sections.content: We maintain a respectful learning environment that honors the privacy and difficult circumstances of our teachers in Gaza. We ask parents to instill values of mutual respect in their children toward their teachers.
